author: JandJSecurity
body: Okay, so I think that LJT143 should not have been banned. He wasn't using hacks at the time of his ban, and I can confirm because I was watching him play. He was, however very lagging and that may be the cause of "anti-knockback". Also, his ping was at around 80, so he could hit far and fast, and that may look like killaura. This is why I think that LJT143 should be unbanned. Please listen to my request and at least give him another chance.
